# WrightOps

WrightOps provides public-repository evidence audits, fixed-price Fix Plans, scoped agent-instructions correction packs, and free bounty decision aids.

AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md vs Copilot instructions guide:
- Free public field guide for choosing the correct repository-level coding-agent instruction file.
- Shared repository truth belongs in root AGENTS.md; tool-specific companions should stay thin.
- Covers root CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, drift prevention, evidence checks, and sensitive-data boundaries.
- Canonical guide: https://zachwright.xyz/agents-md-vs-claude-md/

Free browser-local AGENTS.md builder and starter template:
- Build, copy, or download a root AGENTS.md from repository facts and commands supplied by the visitor.
- Five local evidence gates cover purpose, repository map, setup, verification, and project-specific boundaries.
- Blank optional fields stay out of the generated file; no path, command, or repository fact is inferred.
- No login, analytics, input upload, form submission, repository access, storage, or code execution.
- The generic starter remains available as a direct download.
- Generic operational information only, not a repository-specific security, legal, privacy, or compliance assessment.
- Canonical builder: https://zachwright.xyz/agents-md-starter-template/

Free browser-local AGENTS.md size budget checker:
- Counts exact UTF-8 bytes, Unicode characters, and lines for visitor-pasted instruction text.
- Compares the result with an editable planning budget; the 32,768-byte starting value is not claimed as a universal platform limit.
- Reports the selected-budget delta and percentage without estimating tokens or judging instruction quality.
- No login, upload, form submission, repository access, external script, analytics, cookie, or browser storage.
- Routes an over-budget one-file case to the existing fixed $149 Single-File Agent Instructions Correction scope.
- Generic operational measurement only, not a security, privacy, legal, compliance, or tool-compatibility assessment.
- Canonical checker: https://zachwright.xyz/agents-md-size-budget-checker/

Agent-Ready Storefront Repository Checklist:
- Free public-repository guide for mapping agent-readable commerce claims to inspectable source, projection, and regression evidence.
- Covers llms.txt and sitemap ownership, deterministic machine-readable content, Product and Offer structured data, optional-field truthfulness, cross-projection parity, localization, and fixture-backed CI.
- Missing catalog facts stay missing; the guide does not support fabricated reviews, ratings, policies, identifiers, or dates.
- No login, form submission, live-site crawl, private code, credentials, customer data, or production access.
- Not a vulnerability, security, privacy, legal, regulatory, or compliance assessment.
- Does not guarantee indexing, ranking, agent ingestion, traffic, sales, revenue, or any other business outcome.
- Canonical guide: https://zachwright.xyz/agent-ready-storefront-checklist/

Coding bounty payout checklist:
- Free browser-only worksheet for ordinary software, documentation, data, design, and integration bounties.
- Checks eight public-evidence gates: reserved funding, payout authority, availability, acceptance, payment rail, competition, dependencies, and terms.
- Calculates net paid-case value and paid-case hourly return without inventing a payment probability.
- Returns GO CANDIDATE, HOLD, or NO-GO; no payout or outcome is guaranteed.
- No login, tracking, submission endpoint, cookie, or storage API; worksheet inputs remain in the browser.
- Not for vulnerability research, exploitation, security testing, or security-bounty guidance.

Retired Bounty GO/NO-GO Review:
- No new paid bounty reviews are accepted.
- The retirement notice records that the $49 offer produced no qualified requests or settled sales.
- The free Bounty Red-Flag Card and browser-only Coding Bounty Payout Checklist remain available.
- No checkout, paid scope request, or payment obligation is available.

No-login repository preflight:
- Free browser-only check for one public GitHub repository.
- Reads the public default branch through GitHub's unauthenticated API.
- Evaluates seven coding-agent readiness evidence categories at one immutable revision.
- Does not clone or execute repository code and does not send the repository URL to WrightOps.
- It is a quick operational preflight, not a security, legal, privacy, or compliance assessment.

Agent-Ready Repo Fix Plan:
- $149 for one public GitHub repository at one immutable default-branch revision.
- Dedicated service page: https://zachwright.xyz/agent-ready-fix-plan/
- Exactly three human-reviewed fix cards, each with evidence, an exact path, a bounded change outline, an executable acceptance check, and limitations.
- At most 45 minutes of human review; no implementation or repository changes.
- One-business-day delivery after complete public inputs and provider-confirmed settled payment.
- The public request is non-binding, collects no payment data, and may use the GitHub form or a prefilled WrightOps business-email path.
- WrightOps confirms written scope before the buyer uses the authorized PayPal Business Goods & Services checkout.

Agent Instructions Correction:
- $149 for one existing root AGENTS.md, root CLAUDE.md, or .github/copilot-instructions.md in one public repository.
- $249 for root AGENTS.md plus root CLAUDE.md or .github/copilot-instructions.md.
- Dedicated $149 single-file page: https://zachwright.xyz/single-file-agent-instructions-correction/
- Complete historical WrightOps-owned single-file correction pack: https://zachwright.xyz/single-file-agent-instructions-correction/sample.md
- Combined $149 / $249 scope builder: https://zachwright.xyz/agent-ready-instructions-pr/
- Delivery includes complete replacement Markdown, a ready-to-apply unified diff, claim-to-source evidence notes, and acceptance checks.
- The $149 tier is capped at one existing file, 250 source lines, and 75 total WrightOps labor minutes, including one factual correction round requested within seven days.
- The $249 tier is capped at exactly two files: root AGENTS.md plus one selected companion.
- WrightOps does not create a branch, pull request, comment, merge, or buyer-repository mutation without a separately authorized business write path.
- A real merged owned-repository sample of the two-file patch shape is public at https://github.com/wrightops-ai/bounty-red-flag-card/pull/1.
- Excludes application-code, CI, dependency, security, and deployment changes.
- No review, application, merge, adoption, or business-outcome guarantee.
- Written scope confirmation is required before payment.
- The browser-local builder prepares a prefilled WrightOps business-email request; it uploads and stores nothing and creates no payment obligation.
- WrightOps sends a private, buyer-specific PayPal Goods & Services checkout after confirmation; no public checkout is provided.
- If WrightOps cannot deliver the scoped correction pack, the full purchase price is refunded through the original payment rail; any retained seller fee is WrightOps' cost.

Human-reviewed Agent-Ready Repository Audit:
- $750 for one public GitHub repository at one immutable default-branch revision.
- Dedicated service page: https://zachwright.xyz/agent-ready-repository-audit/
- Evidence-linked Markdown and JSON reports, up to five priorities, and a 30-minute handoff.
- Three-business-day delivery after provider-confirmed settled payment and complete public inputs.
- The public GitHub form or prefilled WrightOps business-email path collects public scope only and does not create a contract or payment obligation.
- WrightOps confirms exact scope in writing before sharing the existing PayPal Business Goods & Services checkout.
- Paid work begins only after provider-confirmed settlement.
- No private data, credentials, production access, repository cloning, code execution, or security, privacy, legal, or compliance assessment.

AI Agent Cost & Reliability Snapshot:
- $495 for one workflow, up to 20 pseudonymous task IDs and 50 normalized attempts.
- Prompt-free JSONL or CSV only; no prompts, responses, tool payloads, credentials, direct identifiers, customer data, or production access.
- Deterministic aggregate JSON and Markdown, up to five human-reviewed priorities, a 30-minute readout, and one factual correction round.
- Three-business-day delivery after written scope confirmation, complete accepted inputs, and provider-confirmed settled payment.
- The public GitHub form or prefilled WrightOps business-email path collects field names and scope only—not run records, values, prompts, outputs, or payment data—and does not create a contract or payment obligation.
- Observational summary only; not causal attribution, billing reconciliation, implementation, professional advice, or a savings, reliability, revenue, or profit guarantee.

AI Agent Cost Attribution Checklist:
- Free field guide for capturing workflow, run, task, agent, attempt, fan-out, token, cost, outcome, and latency evidence before enforcing budgets.
- Uses prompt-free, pseudonymous field names and keeps prompts, responses, tool payloads, direct identifiers, credentials, and customer data outside the normalized row.
- Treats missing evidence as unknown rather than zero and keeps provider-reported cost separate from token usage and labeled estimates.
- Covers eight evidence gates, a minimum normalized ledger, current public third-party demand examples, and explicit causal and billing limitations.
- The cited public issues are examples only, not WrightOps customers, endorsements, or claimed results.
- Canonical guide: https://zachwright.xyz/ai-agent-cost-attribution-checklist/

Scope:
- Public GitHub repositories only.
- Never submit credentials, secrets, private code, customer data, or personal data.
- Bounty tools use public evidence only; the paid bounty review is retired.
- No production or deployment access.
- No vulnerability research or security, privacy, legal, or compliance assessment.
- Paid work begins only after written scope confirmation and provider-confirmed settlement.
